title: Indigenous political ecologies of the shoreline
description: Focuses on coastlines, seabeds, river banks, flood plains and other spaces where water and earth meet, course material will draw from cross-disciplinary scholarship in Indigenous geography, law, politics, ecologies, and philosophies, as well as non-scholarly representations of Indigenous cultural practices, histories and resurgent struggles situated at the shore.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ES 413, ES 480 (if taken in the same topic).
